units.rawText: I've written many stories in the past, but no matter what I do, I can't fill up that gap in my life and get rid of the emptiness and fear it brings.

units.rawText: I once thought that I would just have to live on with that emptiness and fear, until one day when my neural cloud system would finally give up that ghost and crash for good.

units.rawText: And then, I met you, like a mentor from all those heroic stories. I wasn't able to make sense of it for a long time, but I learned how to face my present and pen my future.
